d:
Congress leader Rahul Gandhi targeted Punjab Chief Minister Bhagwant Mann over the issue of drugs in Punjab. During his remarks, Rahul Gandhi made a sharp comment about Mann, saying that alcohol can be smelled on his breath. He also raised concerns over the drug problem in the state. Watch the video to know what Rahul Gandhi said and how he questioned the Punjab government's handling of the issue.
